key_insight: Strong performance on isolated medical tasks did not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers across a patient's nasopharyngeal carcinoma care pathway.
clinical_relevance: NPCBench tests capabilities relevant to oncology workflows, including visual evidence use, longitudinal reasoning, and integrated care planning.
method: Models specialist apprenticeship from foundational knowledge to case planning and consultation.
Links multimodal, stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories.
Uses episode-level scoring, paired controls, and physician calibration.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered 30 models, 4,777 component and consultation items, and 100 CarePath patients with 417 scored tasks; strict CarePath success peaked at 23% among 21 multimodal models.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish safety or effectiveness in real-world clinical care.
paper_title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
